name: Codex CLI

requirements.hint: Install Rust with rustup from https://rustup.rs; rustup picks up the toolchain each release pins
Install Rust with rustup from https://rustup.rs
Install Python 3.11 or newer; Codex builds with its own package builder, scripts/build_codex_package.py

typecheck: cd codex-rs && cargo check -p codex-cli --bin codex
build: cd codex-rs && sed -i.openmods.bak 's/^version\.workspace = true$/version = "'"${OPENMODS_VERSION}+${OPENMODS_MODS}"'"/' cli/Cargo.toml && rm -f cli/Cargo.toml.openmods.bak && cd .. && rm -rf codex-rs/target/openmods-package && CODEX_REPO_ROOT="$PWD" CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OPT_LEVEL=1 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=none CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=symbols CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=off CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16 python3 scripts/build_codex_package.py --cargo-profile release --target "$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')" --package-dir codex-rs/target/openmods-package
dev: (cd {root} && rm -rf codex-rs/target/openmods-dev-package && CODEX_REPO_ROOT={root} python3 scripts/build_codex_package.py --target "$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')" --package-dir codex-rs/target/openmods-dev-package) && exec {root}/codex-rs/target/openmods-dev-package/bin/codex
